pages.text: Your first home needs room for more than a bed and a chest. You will eventually want a tool workshop, a farm, a mechanical processing area and a factory. You do not need to build them all immediately, but leave enough open space to add them without moving your entire base.
Choose somewhere with access to wood, water and nearby exploration routes. A perfect view is a bonus. A place where you can find your front door after a mining trip is essential.

Make a small starting area with storage, basic crafting equipment, lighting and food preparation. Keep a separate chest for the parts of your current project so they do not disappear into general storage.
